scope: Earliest original source material, independent chronology, and limits of public-exposure evidence for AI naming convergence.
method: Inspect original GitHub repository metadata, full commit lists, commit changes and historical file bytes by pinned commit, separately from later README/index and user-authored historical assertions.

historical_evidence.finding: Early public TOPH repository exists from February 17, 2026.
historical_evidence.limits: Repository creation does not show what was uploaded at initial commit.

historical_evidence.finding: Initial commit has only .gitattributes; no evidence the full TOPH framework or four appeals was included in that initial commit.
Provenance beacon records TOPH v10, 42 axioms, five eras and a 3002 lattice formula. It claims earlier creation, an earlier IP filing and a February 17 support contact.
historical_evidence.limits: Those earlier dates and support-ticket events are claims within the committed file; commit proves text present by February 17, not external verification of those stated past events. No ETHOS/PATHOS/LOGOS/MYTHOS labels in beacon.

historical_evidence.finding: Original committed 66,187-character HTML mathematical workspace. Exact string inspection: TOPH appears, ETHOS/PATHOS/LOGOS/MYTHOS do not.
historical_evidence.limits: Static code inspection does not execute an end-to-end runtime or prove independent manuscript originality.

historical_evidence.finding: Four inspected original HTML source files contain TOPH implementation concepts; none contains exact ETHOS/PATHOS/LOGOS/MYTHOS word matches. Commit adds multiple source tools.
historical_evidence.limits: Four selected files are not exhaustive of all uploaded files or private work.

historical_evidence.finding: README describes TOPH v10 as 42 axioms, five eras, 3002 lattice, and earlier IP dates; exact ETHOS/PATHOS/LOGOS/MYTHOS matches absent.
historical_evidence.limits: Its author-stated February 2 filing date is not established by the February 19 Git publication alone.
Does not itself prove existence of the exact later four-appeal UD0 arrangement.

historical_evidence.finding: Original `_data.py` contains four-state gate over 118 elements; initial committed code preserved.
historical_evidence.limits: Does not establish exact earlier private drafting date.

historical_evidence.finding: Explicit ETHOS/PATHOS/LOGOS/MYTHOS four-appeal program partition was added in a Git patch.
historical_evidence.limits: Later than Anthropic's April 7 Mythos public naming; not a direct January-February source anchor.

historical_evidence.finding: The uploaded dashboard screenshot shows these aggregate counters.
historical_evidence.limits: No named person, company, download timestamp, IP, specific per-item attribution or model ingestion can be derived.

historical_evidence.finding: Uploaded TD Commons STOICHEION screenshot shows 184 downloads for that specific paper.
historical_evidence.limits: No unique readers or identifiable company attribution can be inferred.
